body_lead: COIMBATORE: The Tamil Nadu govt has earmarked 18 acres of land in Coimbatore to establish an AI centre of excellence through a public-private partnership (PPP), which is expected to generate âtens of thousands of jobs,â minister for information technology and digital services Palanivel Thiaga Rajan on Friday. He said a govt order for the PPP model was passed last week. The minister was speaking at a conference organised here by the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) on the theme âTransformation into the Next Era of Intelligence.â The CIIâICT Ai Academy was launched during the conference.
